```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(lubridate)
```

# Load data

```{r}
bryte <- read_excel("data//bespoke_datasets//bryte_near_others.xlsx")
menlo <- read_excel("data//bespoke_datasets//menlo_near_others.xlsx")
ucd <- read_excel("data//bespoke_datasets//ucd_near_others.xlsx")
basemap <- st_read("data//shapefiles//WW_Delta.shp")
```

# narrow where timeframes are within 1 week and locations are appropriate for comparison

```{r}
bryte_filtered <- bryte %>%
  filter(abs(as.numeric(difftime(
    bryte_date, otherlab_date, units = "days"
  ))) <= 5) 

#Check to see that matched samples are realistic (filter to where assigned place names are different)
bryte_filtered_diffs <- bryte_filtered %>% filter(!bryte_placename == otherlab_placename) %>% select(OBJECTID, bryte_placename, bryte_latitude, bryte_longitude, otherlab_placename, otherlab_latitude, otherlab_longitude)
bryte_filtered_diffs

bryte_pts <- st_as_sf(
  bryte_filtered_diffs,
  coords = c("bryte_longitude", "bryte_latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

otherlab_pts <- st_as_sf(
  bryte_filtered_diffs,
  coords = c("otherlab_longitude", "otherlab_latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

bryte_pts <- st_transform(bryte_pts, 4326)
otherlab_pts <- st_transform(otherlab_pts, 4326)
basemap <- st_transform(basemap, 4326)

leaflet() %>%
addPolygons(
  data = basemap,
  color = "darkblue",
  fillColor = "lightblue",
  fillOpacity = 0.3,
  weight = 1
)%>%

  # UCD sampling locations
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = bryte_pts,
    color = "blue",
    radius = 5,
    stroke = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
  label = ~paste(bryte_placename, " | ID:", OBJECTID),
  popup = ~paste(
    "<b>Place:</b>", bryte_placename,
    "<br><b>OBJECTID:</b>", OBJECTID
  )
  ) %>%

  # Other lab sampling locations
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = otherlab_pts,
    color = "red",
    radius = 5,
    stroke = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
  label = ~paste(otherlab_placename, " | ID:", OBJECTID),
  popup = ~paste(
    "<b>Place:</b>", otherlab_placename,
    "<br><b>OBJECTID:</b>", OBJECTID
  )
  ) 

#List of inappropriate comparisons: 16708, 16577, 14873
bryte_filtered <- bryte_filtered %>% filter(!OBJECTID == 16708) %>%
    filter(!OBJECTID == 16577)%>%
    filter(!OBJECTID == 14873)
```

# Explore

```{r}
#Bryte
# Plot regression, color by lab
ggplot(bryte_filtered, aes(x = otherlab_chl_ugl, y = bryte_chl_ugl, color = otherlab_lab)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot regression, color by lab
ggplot(bryte_filtered, aes(x = otherlab_chl_ugl, y = bryte_chl_ugl, color = otherlab_lab)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 30) +
  xlim(0, 30) 

ggplot(bryte_filtered, aes(x = log(otherlab_chl_ugl), y = log(bryte_chl_ugl), color = otherlab_lab)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#There are only enough data points fo compare Bryte data to NWQL_CBL data.

bryte_v_cawsc <- bryte_filtered %>% filter(otherlab_lab == "nwql_cbl")

b_v_c <-t.test(bryte_v_cawsc$bryte_chl_ugl, bryte_v_cawsc$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
b_v_c#not diff
```


```{r}
#Menlo
ggplot(menlo_filtered, aes(x = otherlab_chl_ugl, y = menlo_chl_ugl, color = otherlab_lab)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(menlo_filtered, aes(x = log(otherlab_chl_ugl), y = log(menlo_chl_ugl), color = otherlab_lab)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#Regression with nwql_cbl looks dang near perfect, UCD looks offset. Only 1 Bryte sample, can't compare. 

menlo_v_cawsc <- menlo_filtered %>% filter(otherlab_lab == "nwql_cbl")

m_v_c <- t.test(menlo_v_cawsc$menlo_chl_ugl, menlo_v_cawsc$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
m_v_c#not different!!!

menlo_v_ucd <- menlo_filtered %>% filter(otherlab_lab == "ucd")

m_v_u <- t.test(menlo_v_ucd$menlo_chl_ugl, menlo_v_ucd$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
m_v_u #oof, these are different. 
```


```{r}
# UCD
ggplot(ucd_filtered, aes(x = otherlab_chl_ugl, y = ucd_chl_ugl, color = otherlab_lab)) +

ggplot(ucd_filtered, aes(x = log(otherlab_chl_ugl), y = log(ucd_chl_ugl), color = otherlab_lab)) +

ucd_v_cawsc <- ucd_filtered %>% filter(otherlab_lab == "nwql_cbl")

u_v_c <- t.test(ucd_v_cawsc$ucd_chl_ugl, ucd_v_cawsc$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
u_v_c#not different but really inappropriate regression line. 

# Already compared to Menlo, regression line looks slightly better but it is significantly different.
```

#Create clean results table
```{r}

results <- bind_rows(

  tidy(b_v_c) %>%
    mutate(lab1 = "Bryte",
           lab2 = "NWQL and CBL",
           N = sum(complete.cases(bryte_v_cawsc))),

  tidy(m_v_c) %>%
    mutate(lab1 = "Menlo",
           lab2 = "NWQL and CBL",
           N = sum(complete.cases(menlo_v_cawsc))),

  tidy(m_v_u) %>%
    mutate(lab1 = "Menlo",
           lab2 = "UCD",
           N = sum(complete.cases(menlo_v_ucd))),

  tidy(u_v_c) %>%
    mutate(lab1 = "UCD",
           lab2 = "NWQL and CBL",
           N = sum(complete.cases(ucd_v_cawsc)))

) %>%
  select(lab1, lab2, N, estimate, statistic, parameter,
         p.value, conf.low, conf.high, method)

results
```

# The Menlo v UCD comparison anre the only different one. The issue may be the low N. Since the other comparisons are not different. let's combine all other labs to compare similar spacetime UCD measurements. 


```{r}
u_v_all <- t.test(ucd_filtered$ucd_chl_ugl, ucd_filtered$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
u_v_all # still different. 

ggplot(ucd_filtered, aes(x = otherlab_chl_ugl, y = ucd_chl_ugl)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(ucd_filtered, aes(x = log(otherlab_chl_ugl), y = log(ucd_chl_ugl))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#Still flatline in regression. Does not appear to be correctable. Relatively low values but at the 1 to 5is range, there should be a trend and certainly not a flatline.
```


```{r}
# Explore UCD data ranges in similar locs/season/years
ds_data <- read.csv("data//bespoke_datasets//ds_data_by_lab_20261014ER.csv")

ucd_all <- ds_data %>%
  filter(lab == "ucd") %>%
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    month = month(date),
    year = year(date),
    my = paste0(month, year)
  )

latmin = min(ucd_all$latitude)
latmax = max(ucd_all$latitude)
longmin = min(ucd_all$longitude)
longmax = max(ucd_all$longitude)
mylist = unique(ucd_all$my)

ds_ucd_filter <- ds_data  %>%
    mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    month = month(date),
    year = year(date),
    my = paste0(month, year)) %>%
    filter(
    latitude >= latmin,
    latitude <= latmax,
    longitude >= longmin,
    longitude <=longmax,
    my %in% mylist) 

    
testing_pts <- st_as_sf(
  ds_ucd_filter,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

lab_palette <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("red", "blue", "darkgreen", "purple"),
  domain = testing_pts$lab
)

leaflet() %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = basemap,
    color = "darkblue",
    fillColor = "lightblue",
    fillOpacity = 0.3,
    weight = 1
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = testing_pts,
    color = ~lab_palette(as.character(lab)),
    radius = 5,
    stroke = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8
  )

#Too differnt in location ranges to compare broadly with ANOVAs. I want to pivot and correct the sonde data and compare to discretes, maybe we'll have more UCD data comparisons. 
```
